description: Load this skill whenever writing, editing, or reviewing any web content, copy, headings, labels, error messages, or instructions. Under no circumstances write inaccessible content — every piece of text must be clear, structured, and usable by people with cognitive, visual, and language differences. Absolutely always apply plain language, logical heading hierarchy, and meaningful link text.
